sloka: इति तेनातियशसा राक्षसेनाभिचोदिताः।वानरेन्द्रा जहृषिरे लाङ्गूलानि च विव्यधुः ।। ६.९०.१९ ।।
transliteration: iti tenātiyaśasā rākṣasenābhicoditāḥ।vānarendrā jahṛṣire lāṅgūlāni ca vivyadhuḥ ।। 6.90.19 ।।

translations.english: Incited by the encouraging words of Vibheeshana (Rakshasa), Vanara chiefs rejoiced and went shaking their tails.
